entities.summary: Savarinathan Michael Augustine was an Indian prelate of the Catholic Church. He served as the Archbishop of Pondicherry and Cuddalore from 1992 to 2004. He was an honorary member of the Society of Foreign Missions of Paris. He served the church for 39 years as a bishop and for 56 years as a priest. He died on 4 November 2017.
